patch.value: pm search defaults to keyword on a workspace whose vector index is complete, so the shipped Ollama semantic default never reaches the default query path

Measured 2026-09-08 on the live 2719-item workspace. The vectorization ledger (search/vectorization-status.json) reports 2719 of 2719 items embedded with provider ollama, model qwen3-embedding:0.6b, 1024 dimensions, and pm health reports vectorization ok. Yet a bare pm search (the form every skill, AGENTS.md quickstart line and the generated agent-guidance block instruct, 21 fenced occurrences, 0 of them naming a mode) runs in keyword mode: the top result for "make command output cheaper in tokens for coding agents" is the roadmap hub pm-doxj (score 5399) followed by the context-engine hub pm-4k6b, while --mode hybrid returns pm-t5dt4z, pm-kvxqp1 and pm-5t33or (the three items that actually own output token cost) in 1.3 seconds. The cold-start duplicate check every agent performs therefore runs against the weakest retrieval the workspace has.

Three layers agree on the literal and none consults index state: parseSearchMode(undefined) returns "keyword" in src/sdk/query/search-contracts.ts, the CLI re-derives the same literal in src/cli/register-list-query.ts (mode fallback "keyword", help text "default: keyword"), and settings.search has no key for a default mode at all, so no workspace can change it without passing --mode on every call. pm-67uh closed on 2026-05 with the acceptance criterion "When Ollama is available locally, default pm search mode resolves to semantic-capable hybrid behavior with no manual setup; explicit user settings still take precedence". The shipped runtime defaults (semantic-defaults.ts) fill provider, model and vector-store leaves, which is why the index exists, but the mode default itself never moved. The SDK already degrades any semantic failure to keyword hits with a search_semantic_fallback warning, so an index-aware hybrid default cannot block an agent when Ollama is down.

Expected: the default mode is an SDK policy resolved from workspace state and settings, not a presentation-layer literal. A settings key search.default_mode accepts auto, keyword, semantic or hybrid with default auto; auto resolves to hybrid exactly when the built-in semantic path can run (an active embedding provider plus an active vector store or extension adapter, or an extension search provider) and to keyword otherwise; the response reports mode_source (explicit, settings or auto) so the reader can tell a chosen mode from a derived one; the CLI passes mode through unchanged and its help text says auto; docs and the config key registry declare the key.

search.default_mode is a declared settings key (auto|keyword|semantic|hybrid, default auto) accepted by the validator, the nested config registry and pm config set; With auto, a workspace whose embedding provider and vector store resolve runs bare pm search in hybrid mode, and a workspace without them runs keyword, proven by specs in both directions; The search response reports mode_source with values explicit, settings or auto, and the CLI no longer re-derives the default from a literal; pm search --help and docs/COMMANDS.md and docs/CONFIGURATION.md describe the auto default and the key, and the contracts snapshot is regenerated; A bare pm search on this workspace returns the semantic ranking for the measured query and the semantic fallback warning still appears when the provider is unreachable
Bare pm search uses the strongest retrieval the workspace can run, chosen by the SDK from index and provider state, with the choice visible in the response

value.text: An index-aware default must key off the same verdict the diagnostics already publish, not off whether defaults were applied. The first cut of auto treated auto_ollama_defaults_applied as "implicit" and resolved keyword on this very workspace, because one mirror leaf (search.embedding_model) was empty and the defaults filler touched it. resolveProviderConfigSource, the function pm health uses for provider_source, is the honest predicate: configured when the stored search.provider names the active provider.

value.text: Implementation evidence 2026-09-08. SDK: search-contracts.ts gains SearchDefaultMode, SEARCH_DEFAULT_MODE_VALUES, SearchModeSource, resolveSearchDefaultModeSetting and resolveEffectiveSearchMode; search.ts resolves the runtime mode through resolveRuntimeSearchMode, which counts the semantic path as runnable only when resolveProviderConfigSource (the predicate pm health publishes as provider_source) returns configured for the stored search.provider and a vector store or extension adapter resolves, or an extension search provider is active. Settings: search.default_mode (default auto) declared in types, defaults, validator, serializer key order and the nested config registry as search_default_mode. CLI: the keyword literal and its help text are gone; help says default auto. Live on this workspace after the change: bare search mode hybrid, top hits pm-t5dt4z, pm-kvxqp1, pm-5t33or, pm-cu1i (was pm-doxj, pm-4k6b, pm-rnpb, pm-92if); explicit --mode keyword reports mode_source explicit; count-only under auto reports 666 hybrid matches versus 946 keyword. Golden set (pm eval --k 10): hybrid nDCG 0.8244 / MRR 0.90 / recall 0.8364, keyword 0.7451 / 0.80 / 0.8727, semantic 0.7890 / 0.85 / 0.8182. Gate repairs the change required: recurrence family presentation-layer-default-re-derivation registered so the recurs_from edge passes the defect-evidence gate; intent calibration ledger re-approved (+21 bytes of mode_source in the unbounded verbose walk); help text kept at the previous token length because the lexicon ratchet has zero headroom; compact responses omit mode_source for explicit and auto after the agent-task token ratchet showed six tokens per search for a fact the default already states. Targeted specs: 100 of 100 across search-command and search-default-mode, 188 across the settings, constants, alias and nested-settings suites.
